scope: Original asset byte preservation; plain layer validation; source-frame matching, endpoint attachment, deformation, explosion and independent toggling. No pressure, force or arbitrary collision proof.
checks: All 42 original GLBs, original manifest/runtime and original procedural sources unchanged
Three self-contained plain GLBs with no validator errors/warnings
Same unique names, root placement and driver/socket frames across layer tiers
Original skeleton receives no TRS edits from muscle updates
All tendon endpoints remain on authored attachment points during inspection
Muscle thickness responds to endpoint distance while tendon radius remains constant
Exploded modules preserve muscle lengths and orientation
Shared translated/rotated/scaled instance wrapper does not double-transform the layer
Distance layer preserves game bounds and does not animate
Combined geometry costs reported separately; production composite remains over budget
